profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: My name is Lam Nguyen, and I am a software engineer currently living in Austin, Texas. I attended Purdue University where I received my Bachelor's degree in Computer Graphic Technology. I enjoy creating interactive and dynamic web applications with beautiful user interface. I am a passionate and hard-working individual who strives to get better at what I do everyday. In my free time, I like to learn new technologies and dev tools to keep up with current trends in the tech industry. I am a laid-back person, and I love being active such as playing sports and working out.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the frontend effort on an internal project where I contributed as a frontend lead in building a web application that enables Apple Care Team Managers across the globe to effectively manage their team.

The application is used by more than 5000 Team Managers to coach Customer Support Advisors with their everyday tasks. Team Managers are able to increase their team’s productivity by maximizing advisors’ time on the service lines, thus increasing issue resolutions and customer satisfaction.

Acting as a team lead, I manage a team of frontend engineers. I help mentor my team and serve as a guide to help them meet deadlines in a timely manner without compromising code quality. Additionally, I collaborate with a UI/UX designer to come up with high fidelity mock-ups for features that the frontend team would be implementing.

I work with the business team, product manager, project manager, backend team, and other stakeholders to gather requirements; then come up with a plan, delegate tasks to team members, implement solutions, carry out testings and code reviews, and provide post-release support.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · SASS · TypeScript · JavaScript · Git · HTML5 · npm · React.js · CSS

positions.title: PS Staff Web Developer/Consultant
positions.description:
Proficient in NetSuite's state-of-the-art ERP system and their eCommerce platform, SuiteCommerce Advanced. Employ Backbone JS framework in the front end along with other libraries like Underscore and Handlebars to write maintainable and reusable code. Utilize Sass and Bootstrap for efficient, responsive, and precise UI design. Node.js is used in the backend to interface with the NetSuite ERP system to persist and read data. Make use of Gulp.js for local development and bundling assets for deployments. Effectively work in small team to deliver custom eCommerce solution to clients leveraging the SuiteCommerce Advanced framework. Practice Agile methodology to collaboratively execute sprints in a timely, quality fashion.

The Datto Project:
NetSuite's eCommerce platform, SuiteCommerce Advanced, is known for building online retail stores. With the Datto project, that I got a chance to be apart of for a year, we implemented a custom solution that utilizes the brand new feature from NetSuite ERP called SuiteBilling. We created a web application that manages user's subscriptions to Datto's main services. From the application, user can choose to subscribe to any service they prefer and manage it there. Billing procedure goes through the web application and get processed in the NetSuite ERP. One of the big features that I got to work on is the promotional code system. Users can stack their promo codes by entering multiple of them, and depending on the services that they have subscribed in their cart, the promo codes would apply accordingly and provide them with discounts.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Developed websites on Wordpress for multiple clients such as Indiana Packers and Myte Corporation. Utilized SEO methodologies to drive traffic to clients' websites. Implemented layouts using best web practices to enhance User Experience, as well as to optimize page load time. Expanded my web development skill-sets by programming in PHP, Javascript, HTML, and CSS.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Successfully managed and maintained company websites, as well as implemented new designs to company’s sale site and IntelliHire's Applicant Tracking System platform, by programming in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

Created graphics for web developing purpose across both company’s sale site and portal site by utilizing extensive knowledge and experience in Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, InDesign, and Illustrator.

positions.title: Dance Instructor
positions.description: Managed and taught 20+ kids ranging from 10-18 years old, as well as prepared them for a recital in the spring, by teaching advanced Hip Hop choreography and spread awareness about the art of Hip Hop dancing.

projects.title: Pacetub
projects.description:
A semi-robust task tracking web application. For my job at Oracle, I needed a simple app that keeps track of my daily tasks and the amount of time I spend on them. I looked around for an app like that, but all that I can find are either some type of calendar app or apps that are way too overkill for my need. So I set out to build my own app to help with my daily workflow.

This is a very simple task tracking application that focuses on providing users with an overview of their weekly activities. I focus on simple UI design that I hope to deliver the best experience to users. This is the first of many phases of this application. There's a lot more features I want to continue to add to the application. But for right now, you can check out what I have built so far.

Github link:
https://github.com/lnguyendev/pacetub
